h1_old: How to Dismiss a Traffic Ticket in Dallas with Defensive Driving

faqs.q: How much does it cost to dismiss a ticket in Dallas?
faqs.a: The court's cost is typically up to about $144 ($169 in a school zone), set by each court — some Dallas-area courts charge less. The TDLR-approved course is separate; ours is $28. See your court's page for the exact figure.

faqs.q: Can I take the Dallas defensive driving course online?
faqs.a: Yes. After the court approves your request, a TDLR-approved 6-hour course can be done fully online and the certificate submitted. Every Dallas-area court accepts a state-approved online course.

faqs.q: My ticket is from Irving / Garland / Mesquite, not Dallas. Does that matter?
faqs.a: The legal steps are the same, but you deal with that city's court, not the City of Dallas — and each sets its own fee, request method, and deadlines. Open its page in the table above.

faqs.q: How long do I have to complete it?
faqs.a: Usually 90 days after the court grants your request. Request the course by your appearance date first, and don't pay the ticket — paying is a guilty plea and a conviction.

faqs.q: Will a dismissal keep the ticket off my insurance?
faqs.a: Yes. A driving safety course dismissal keeps the charge off your driving record under Texas law, so it can't raise your insurance — unlike paying it, which is a conviction.

courts.name: Dallas Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS to submit with your certificate. Court fee: $144.

courts.note: Addison lets you apply for DSC online and pay by card, but the fee depends on your offense date — call the clerk.

courts.name: Balch Springs Municipal Court
courts.note: Balch Springs gives you 20 days from the citation date to request DSC — $144 fee, Texas license required.

courts.note: We don't have Carrollton Municipal Court's specific DSC steps yet — call the clerk to confirm the fee, deadline, and how to submit.

courts.name: Cedar Hill Municipal Court
courts.note: Cedar Hill requires a signed DSC affidavit before you enroll — most drivers miss this step. Court fee: $144.

courts.name: Cockrell Hill Municipal Court
courts.note: Cockrell Hill wants you to call first (option #2), then submit your plea and payment before your appearance date.

courts.name: Coppell Municipal Court
courts.note: Coppell takes DSC requests online — pay the $144 fee and upload your license and insurance. 90 days, no extensions.

courts.name: Desoto Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS to submit with your certificate. Court fee: $144.

courts.name: Duncanville Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS — most drivers do not have this ready.

courts.name: Garland Municipal Court
courts.note: You'll need a certified Type 3A driving record from Texas DPS to submit with your certificate. Court fee: $144.
